issue_context.title: [KMSv2] Use expiring cache
comments: Hey @aramase! Release Bug Triage Shadow here - I just wanted to see if this is still on track for the 1.26 release?

> Hey @aramase! Release Bug Triage Shadow here - I just wanted to see if this is still on track for the 1.26 release?

@cailynse Yes it is!
Amazing! Thanks for the prompt update!

review_comments:
Reading through the code I actually think we want:

```suggestion
		cache: utilcache.NewLRUExpireCacheWithClock(100 MB, clock),
```

This cache supports both TTL based expiration while limiting the max size of the cache.
`NewLRUExpireCacheWithClock` seems to be missing a GC loop but that should be easy enough to add.
Hmm is there an equivalent metric for the new cache type?
This should probably `panic` if `key` is empty or `transformer` is `nil`.
Should we still be testing this limit?
good catch! I had removed those tests because we were using just the expiring cache before. Adding the test back now.
update the godoc on the CacheSize field to indicate the field is only allowed for kms v1
Please create an issue for this (can be the same issue that tracks the new cache implementation work).  And for adding `TestEnvelopeCacheLimit` back (if it makes sense for the new cache).
I am trying to think of how we can more rigorously test the new cache type...
